records.title: YOLO-Master: MOE-Accelerated with Specialized Transformers for Enhanced Real-time Detection
records.reason: YOLO-Master uses expert-specialized transformers for real-time object detection and evaluates FPS/latency on an accelerator. The efficiency target is task-specific vision detection, with only a broad MoE connection to LLM inference.

records.title: Cameras as Relative Positional Encoding
records.reason: Camera-relative positional encoding improves multi-view geometry representation; experiments concern camera/3D vision and do not propose LLM inference efficiency or context-window optimization.

records.title: Reconstruction or Semantics? What Makes a Latent Space Useful for Robotic World Models
records.reason: The paper compares reconstruction and semantic latent spaces for robot world models. Its objective is representation quality for robotics, not LLM inference efficiency.

records.title: LUNE: Efficient LLM Unlearning via LoRA Fine-Tuning with Negative Examples
records.reason: LUNE applies LoRA and negative examples for efficient LLM unlearning, reducing unlearning fine-tuning compute/memory relative to full fine-tuning. The gains are training/unlearning cost rather than inference efficiency; linked sparse-transformer lineage is indirect.

records.title: FrontierCS: Evolving Challenges for Evolving Intelligence
records.reason: FrontierCS introduces evolving computer-science programming challenges and evaluates coding capability. It does not propose model-serving or inference optimization.
